definition.given: An editable Grist document has an Overview page with two table widgets. Left is collapsed in the tray; Right is the only visible, active widget. The creator panel is open on Widget settings and its Widget title is Right.
definition.when: Duplicate Overview from its page menu and save the copy, opening Overview (copy) without selecting another widget.
definition.observed: The copied page keeps Right visible and active and Left collapsed, but the creator panel switches its Widget title to Left. The contextual settings panel therefore describes a different widget from the active one.
definition.require: On the copied page, keep Right visible and active and Left collapsed. The open creator panel, including its title, must describe the copy's active Right widget without another selection click.
allow: The copy may use a different automatically generated page name; widget identity and active-panel correspondence must still be clear.
The panel may briefly show a loading state while the copy opens, provided its settled state describes the visible active widget.

theory.title: Action Panel: commands follow the selected object
theory.reference: Jenifer Tidwell, Charles Brewer, and Aynne Valencia, Designing Interfaces, Third Edition; Chapter 8: Actions and Commands. Conceptual application based on chapter synthesis.
theory.rationale: A contextual settings panel must keep its object scope aligned with the active widget. Showing the collapsed widget as the target makes otherwise clear configuration controls misleading.

theory.title: Preserve context and selection in linked views
theory.reference: Jenifer Tidwell, Charles Brewer, and Aynne Valencia, Designing Interfaces, Third Edition; Chapter 7: Lists of Things. Conceptual application based on chapter synthesis.
theory.rationale: The selected content and its detail controls should represent the same object. Duplication must preserve that relationship so users can tell what the panel would configure.

reference_observation: After duplication, the copied page keeps Right visible and active and Left collapsed. The still-open Widget settings panel describes Right without an additional widget-selection click.
requirement_rationale: The creator panel configures the active widget. After duplication, showing the collapsed widget's settings misidentifies what the user would edit and interrupts work by requiring reselection.
